verdict.rationale: The skills are published in a public GitHub repository (anthropics/skills), and their SKILL.md files are directly readable as raw source. Anthropic also says it has published Agent Skills as an open standard. However, no evidence states which license covers the repository's code, so the open-license half of the story is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license (e.g., a LICENSE file or license statement) for the skills repo, and confirmation that all skills (including the document skills) are openly licensed rather than just source-visible.
